companies.name: Northwind Logistics
companies.description: Distributed logistics company evaluating a centralized platform. Primary sponsor: VP of Sales.

calls.notes: Initial discovery call. Northwind Logistics operates a distributed sales and operations team. They want a centralized platform with role-based access, reporting, and easy onboarding. The VP of Sales is the primary business sponsor.
Pricing discussion. The CFO objected to the per-seat pricing model because the customer has many occasional users. The CFO asked whether an annual contract with predictable pricing could be offered.
Competitive discussion. The customer mentioned Salesforce as an alternative being evaluated. The customer wants clear evidence that our workflow can be adopted without a long implementation.
Security review. The customer requested security documentation, including information about data protection and access controls. The security team needs this before the deal can move to final review.
Commitment from the sales representative: send the requested security report and documentation to the customer. The customer has not yet confirmed that the security review is complete.
